items.exampleEn: We decorated the office for the holiday party.
items.exampleZh: 我們為了節日派對佈置辦公室。

items.exampleEn: Spray some water on the plants every morning.
items.exampleZh: 每天早上在植物上噴一些水。

items.exampleEn: Please don't let personal problems interfere with your work.
items.exampleZh: 請別讓私人問題干擾你的工作。

items.exampleEn: Check the price tag before you buy it.
items.exampleZh: 買之前先看看價格標籤。

items.exampleEn: The noise from the street distracted the students.
items.exampleZh: 街上的噪音讓學生們分心了。

items.exampleEn: He steered the boat carefully into the harbor.
items.exampleZh: 他小心地把船駛進港口。

items.exampleEn: House prices in the city have soared this year.
The cat retreated under the bed when the guests arrived.
items.exampleZh: 客人一到，貓就退回床底下躲起來。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel put a tag with my room number on my suitcase.
items.sentenceZh: 飯店在我的行李箱上掛了一張寫著房號的標籤。

items.audioEn: Sales of fans soared during the hot weather last week.
items.audioZh: 上週天氣炎熱期間，電風扇的銷量暴增。
items.questionZh: 上週電風扇的銷售情況如何？

items.sentenceEn: Turn off your phone so it won't distract you during the exam.
items.sentenceZh: 把手機關掉，考試時它才不會讓你分心。

items.sentenceEn: My neighbor sprayed paint on the old fence to make it look new.
items.sentenceZh: 我鄰居在舊籬笆上噴漆，讓它看起來像新的。

items.stemEn: Bad weather can ____ with flight schedules in winter.
items.stemZh: 冬天時，惡劣天氣可能會干擾班機時刻。

items.stemEn: My aunt likes to ____ her kitchen with old family photos.
items.stemZh: 我阿姨喜歡用家裡的老照片裝飾她的廚房。

items.passageEn: Every autumn, our company holds a three-day retreat by a lake. This year, the organizers decorated the main room with paper flowers, and everyone got a name tag at the door. On the second day, we went sailing. I had never steered a boat before, and when a strong wind came, I panicked and wanted to retreat to the shore. Our coach told me to stay calm and not to let fear interfere with my judgment. Birds soared above us, which almost distracted me again! The rest of the day was somewhat calmer. In the evening, someone sprayed bug spray on all our arms and legs, and we laughed because it smelled terrible. It was the best retreat we have ever had.
items.passageZh: 每年秋天，我們公司都會在湖邊舉辦為期三天的員工旅遊。今年，主辦人用紙花佈置了主廳，每個人進門時都拿到一張名牌。第二天我們去駕帆船。我從來沒掌過舵，一陣強風吹來，我就慌了，只想退回岸邊。教練要我保持冷靜，別讓恐懼干擾判斷。鳥兒在我們頭上高飛，差點又讓我分心！那天接下來的時間稍微平靜了一些。晚上，有人往大家的手腳上噴防蚊液，大家都笑了，因為味道超難聞。那是我們辦過最棒的一次員工旅遊。

questions.questionZh: 作者第一次掌舵時發生了什麼事？
options: 遇到一陣強風，作者很慌張
船撞到岸邊，作者受了傷
他掉進湖裡，全身都濕了
有人在營火旁邊唱歌很難聽
房間天花板的紙花全都掉下來了
教練講了一個好笑的笑話

items.promptZh: 工作時，手機常常讓我分心。
referenceEn: My phone often distracts me when I am working.
When I work, my phone often distracts me.
rubricZh: distract 後面接被干擾的人（例如 distracts me）；寫 I often get distracted by my phone 也正確
「常常」可寫 often、usually 等，習慣用現在簡單式

items.instructionZh: 用 decorate 造一個句子，說說你怎麼佈置家裡或辦公室。
referenceEn: I decorated my bedroom wall with posters of my favorite band.
I like to decorate my living room with plants.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 decorate，常用 decorate…with…（例如 decorate my desk with photos）
句子要說到你自己佈置的地方和東西
